user_question: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Clip hospitals to Centre County
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict hospital points to the supplied Centre County county-subdivision boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the hospital point layer using the county-subdivision polygon layer as the clipping boundary. Preserve the hospital point attributes and write the result as a GeoPackage vector layer.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the number of clipped hospitals within each supplied Centre County census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count point features from the clipped hospital layer within each census tract polygon. Store the count in a new field named hospital_count and write the result as a GeoPackage vector layer.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital-count choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce an interactive choropleth map showing hospital counts by census tract across Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth map from the tract layer with hospital_count as the mapped field. Embed the source artifact and CRS verification metadata.
